subject: Log forwarding & retention — vendor quotes and proposed cost-sharing
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya@datadog.com>, Alex Chen <alex@grafana.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan@sentry.io>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Log forwarding & retention — vendor quotes and proposed cost-sharing

Hi all,

We’re approaching renewal season for our observability stack and I want to coordinate a consolidated set of options for the infra/product/security stakeholders. High level:
- Datadog (metrics + logs) renewal due mid-August.
- Grafana Cloud (logs + long-term storage) retention add-on evaluation.
- Sentry (error telemetry) optional for retention tiering if it helps reduce Datadog egress.

Ask: could each vendor provide a 12-month quote including retention-tier pricing and any consolidation/volume discounts for cross-product usage? Specifically include: 30/90/365 day tiers for raw logs, any cold storage/ingest discounts, and a short note on whether forwarding to a cheaper blob store (GCS/Azure Blob) changes unit costs.

Internal note: attaching cost_split_draft.xlsx — early idea is to split the incremental retention add-on across Infrastructure, Platform (product), and Security (incident response) based on usage. Hannah/Connor/Marissa — please confirm whether you want a straight 40/35/25 split or if you prefer the usage-based numbers in the sheet.

Timeline: collect vendor replies by EOD Wed (7/2), ops + finance decision by 7/10 to give procurement time for PO/DC approvals.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Menon <priya@datadog.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Log forwarding & retention — vendor quotes and proposed cost-sharing

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the note — and appreciate the consolidated ask. Attached is a draft quote for a 12-month Datadog contract reflecting our logs + retention add-on. Highlights:
- Base logs + APM: unchanged.
- Retention add-on pricing tiers included for 30/90/365 days (see Datadog_Q3_quote.pdf).
- If you forward cold logs to GCS and use Datadog for indexing/short-term hot storage, there is a predictable per-ingest fee plus a reduced retention indexing cost — we included a sample blended rate.
- We can offer a 10% bundle discount if you commit both logs (indexing) and retention add-ons on a single PO for 12 months.

I’ve included a short summary here; the full pricing sheet is attached. Happy to jump on a 20–30 minute call with Connor/Marissa to walk through the line items. If you want to move forward with the bundle discount, I can send a DocuSign link for signatures.

Best,
Priya
Priya Menon
Senior Account Executive, Datadog
Attachments: Datadog_Q3_quote.pdf

From: Alex Chen <alex@grafana.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Log forwarding & retention — vendor quotes and proposed cost-sharing

Hi Lauren and team,

Appreciate the clear asks. I attached a retention add-on workbook that outlines 30/90/365 pricing and an example of forwarding raw logs into our cold storage layer (Grafana Cloud S3-backed cold tier). Key items:
- We can offer a 15% consolidation credit if you consolidate dashboarding + long-term retention on Grafana Cloud for logs currently indexed in Datadog — depends on contract terms.
- Forwarding to a third-party blob (GCS) is supported, but egress and storage pricing will be vendor-dependent; we included an example where Grafana ingests and writes cold data directly to your GCS bucket which lowers our per-ingest indexing fee.
- If you sign both Datadog and Grafana on a single procurement cadence, we can provide timing credits to align renewals (helps avoid proration).

Attached: GrafanaCloud_retention_addon.xlsx. Happy to schedule a quick alignment call with Connor to map timing and discounts.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Partner Sales, Grafana Labs

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Log forwarding & retention — vendor quotes and proposed cost-sharing

Thanks for the quick vendor responses — and thanks Priya/Alex for the attachments. Summary / proposed next steps:

Summary of vendor options (high level)
- Datadog: standard logs + retention add-on. 10% bundle discount if we commit to both indexing and retention on a single 12-month PO.
- Grafana Cloud: retention add-on with potential 15% consolidation credit if we move dashboarding + retention. Supports direct cold writes to our GCS to reduce egress.

Proposal for internal decision:
- Connor: lead vendor negotiation (pricing + timing alignment).
- Marissa: confirm cost-allocation approach with Finance (I recommend we start with the usage-based numbers in cost_split_draft.xlsx; if Finance pushes back we can default to 40/35/25).
- Hannah: validate security/incident response needs for the 365-day window and sign off on whether Sentry needs expanded retention (if yes, we’ll request Sentry to propose a retention-only quote).

If we proceed with the Datadog bundle discount, Priya said she can push a DocuSign link — I’ve added the DocuSign link to related_links. Also attaching a procurement_po_template.pdf to speed approvals once PRs are raised.

Action items:
- Connor: set up 30-min vendor alignment call (include Priya + Alex) by 7/3.
- Marissa: confirm allocation approach with Finance by 7/6.
- Hannah: reply with security retention sign-off by 7/6.

If anyone wants to change allocation or timeline shout now — otherwise I’ll take these actions as confirmed.

—Lauren
